name: Poshte Parde
overview: This series, produced by artists from Yazd and Tehran, deals with social issues, including childbearing, and in this way introduces the audience to the lifestyle of the people of Yazd province. The behind-the-scenes series, which depicts the customs, culture, and identity of Yazd families, was produced at the Nehzat Media Arts Center in cooperation with the Governor's Office and Yazd Province Broadcasting and Television.
